title: 第124章巧计解危局第123章情字困英雄
content_zh:
盛唐元启三年，秋。
朔风卷着枯叶，狠狠拍打着镇北军驻地的辕门，萧瑟寒意浸透整座军营。短短三日之间，局势陡转直下，曾经固若金汤的北疆防线，如今彻底陷入绝境。
萧琰立在中军大帐的沙盘前，一身洗得发白的青色长衫，与帐内披甲持刃、神色肃杀的将士格格不入。他本是朝堂委派的随军谋士，无兵权、无品级，仅凭一身智谋辅佐镇北将军卫凛驻守北疆，可如今，却成了整座军营唯一的破局希望。
帐内气氛压抑得如同凝固的寒冰，十余位高阶武将分列两侧，个个面色铁青，眉宇间满是焦灼与愤懑。案上摊着三封加急谍报，墨迹淋漓，字字诛心，每一字都宣判着他们的窘迫与危局。
第一封，是粮草谍报：押运粮草的千石粮车在黑风峡遭劫，押送兵士全数殉国，入冬军粮损耗九成，全军三万将士，仅剩三日口粮。
第二封，是边防急报：北狄铁骑趁虚而入，连破三座外围烽燧，如今重兵压境，距主营仅八十里，旦夕可至。
第三封，是朝堂密旨：御史台弹劾镇北军私通外敌、虚报战功，圣上震怒，责令卫凛即刻卸甲回京待审，新任节度使已在途中，暂接管军务。
三重危机，层层叠加，如三座大山轰然压下。断粮、外敌、内疑，绝境之势，无解无逃。
“萧谋士，事到如今，你倒是说句话！”一名满脸虬髯的参将按捺不住，踏前一步，声线粗哑，满是焦躁，“粮草断绝，敌军压境，朝堂还要问罪！我等拼死戍边，未曾战死沙场，反倒要死于朝堂奸人构陷！如今将士军心浮动，再无对策，不等北狄来攻，我军必然不战自溃！”
话音落下，帐内顿时响起一片低沉的附和声，裹挟着无尽的绝望与愤懑。连日紧绷的心神早已耗尽了众人的底气，绝境之下，军心涣散已是定局。
主帅卫凛端坐主位，一身铠甲冰冷沉重，昔日凌厉的眼眸此刻布满血丝，眉宇间尽是疲惫与无力。他执掌镇北军十余年，镇守北疆大小百战，从未陷入如此进退维谷的死地。
“诸位稍安勿躁。”卫凛抬手压下众人的躁动，目光牢牢落在沙盘前的萧琰身上，语气带着全然的托付，“萧先生智计无双，数次危难皆能逆转乾坤，今日危局，唯有先生能解。我卫凛一身荣辱、全镇北军三万将士性命，尽付先生手中，先生但有所命，全军无有不从！”
众将闻声，纷纷收敛躁动，齐齐看向萧琰。有人眼中尚存希冀，也有人暗藏疑虑。萧琰年少入幕，年纪不过二十五六，虽屡出奇谋、屡建奇功，可如今这般覆顶危局，绝非寻常计谋可解，众人心中难免忐忑。
萧琰缓缓抬眸，神色平静无波，不见半分慌乱焦灼。绝境之中，最忌心浮气躁、自乱阵脚，一旦主事者失了沉稳，全军必将万劫不复。他抬手轻轻抚平沙盘上错乱的地形标识，指尖沉稳有力，目光扫过众人，声音清冽笃定，穿透满帐沉郁：“危局虽险，却并非死局。三重困境，看似环环相扣、无解可破，实则处处破绽，可逐一拆解，借力破局。”
寥寥数语，却如一缕清风破开浓雾，让紧绷压抑的帐内多了一丝生机。众人屏息凝神，静静等候他的谋划。
萧琰转身走到案前，指尖轻点三封谍报，条理清晰地缓缓剖析：“粮草被劫，看似断了根基，实则劫粮者并非北狄兵马。黑风峡地势险峻，北狄骑兵擅旷野冲锋，不擅山地伏击，且此次劫粮不留活口、不取兵器，只焚粮草，目的绝非劫掠物资，而是刻意断我军心、乱我阵脚。”
他一语道破关键，众将皆是一怔，此前众人皆认定是北狄所为，从未深究其中蹊跷。
“再看朝堂弹劾。”萧琰拿起密旨，指尖摩挲着冰冷的宣纸，眸色沉了几分，“御史台突然发难，恰逢北疆战事吃紧、粮草遇劫之时，时机太过巧合。新任节度使赵怀安，素来依附丞相一党，此番火速前来接管军务，意在夺权，而非御敌。丞相苏雍向来忌惮镇北军兵权过重，早有削权之心，此次便是借外敌之势、粮草之失，构陷我军，一举收回北疆兵权。”
“至于北狄压境，更是绝佳良机。”萧琰目光落回沙盘，指尖划过八十里开阔平原，“北狄知晓我军内忧重重、军心不稳、粮草将尽，故而趁势出兵，想要坐收渔翁之利。三方势力各有图谋，看似合围锁死我军生路，实则各怀心思、互不统属，破绽便藏在这人心不齐、图谋各异之中。”
一番透彻剖析，层层拨开危局表象，直击核心要害。众将恍然大悟，焦躁慌乱尽数褪去，眼中重新燃起希冀之光。

“先生所言极是！”方才焦躁的参将沉声开口，“只是知晓症结易，破解困局难。如今粮草仅余三日，敌军近在咫尺，朝堂追责在即，我等如何周旋？”
萧琰唇角勾起一抹沉稳弧度，字字清晰：“破局之法，分三步。一、虚张声势，稳军心、惑外敌；二、顺水推舟，破朝堂构陷、阻权臣夺权；三、借力打力，重创北狄、稳住北疆大局。环环相扣，步步为营，不出十日，危局可解。”
他转身面向卫凛，躬身请命：“将军，若信我萧琰，今日起，全军听我调遣，无需追问缘由，只需依令行事。期间无论外界如何传言、军中如何异动，皆不可动摇军心，可否？”
卫凛毫不犹豫，猛然起身，抬手摘下腰间虎符，重重置于案上，声音铿锵有力：“全镇北军，悉听先生调遣！违令者，军法处置！”
虎符落地，声震大帐，绝境之中，军心彻底凝聚。
萧琰不再多言，即刻发令，一道道指令清晰利落、条理分明，精准落到实处。
“第一令。全军即刻整顿营垒，修缮烽燧、加固防线，各营将士昼夜巡营，旗帜尽出、号角常鸣，务必做出粮草充足、军心稳固、严阵以待之态。传令各灶，三餐照常开火，炊烟不断，哪怕稀释粥粮，也要保证烟火鼎盛，不可让外界窥见我军缺粮实情。”
“第二令。命斥候分三路疾驰而出，一路潜入黑风峡，隐秘探查劫粮兵马踪迹，留存物证；一路北上探查北狄驻军布防、粮草营地；一路快马奔赴京城，暗中联络忠于皇室、与丞相派系对立的言官，传递北疆实情。”
“第三令。封锁粮草被劫真相，军中严禁私议粮草事宜，违者重罚。对外只宣称粮草转运迟缓，不日即可抵达，安定军心，迷惑外敌与朝堂细作。”
军令层层下达，快马即刻出营，沉寂压抑的军营瞬间运转起来，各司其职、井然有序，一扫此前的颓势。
入夜，朔风更烈，寒意刺骨。军营灯火通明，连绵数十里营帐灯火不灭，号角每隔两时辰准时响起，声势浩荡。远远望去，整座主营壁垒森严、士气鼎盛，全然不见断粮绝境的衰败之态。
北狄斥候潜伏在远处山林，彻夜窥探，见此情景，心中惊疑不定，连夜传报主帅：大晟镇北军粮草充足、军心稳固、防备严密，不可贸然进攻，需暂缓进军、静观其变。
北狄主帅收到探报，果然心生忌惮，当即下令全军止步八十里，就地扎营休整，不敢贸然逼近。北狄生性狡诈多疑，素来畏强欺弱，见镇北军气势不减，唯恐暗藏埋伏、贸然进军中计，硬生生停住了兵锋。
第一步计谋，不费一兵一卒，成功暂缓外敌兵锋，为后续破局争取到了宝贵的缓冲时间。
与此同时，朝堂派来的监军已快马抵达军营。此人名为张谦，是丞相苏雍的心腹，此番前来，名为督查军务，实则暗中搜集罪证、配合赵怀安夺权，意图坐实镇北军罪责。
张谦入营之后，四处巡查、刻意打探，暗中观察粮草仓储、将士状态，却见军营秩序井然、炊烟不绝、将士士气高昂，丝毫不像粮草断绝、军心涣散的绝境模样。他心中疑惑不解，却并未放松警惕，暗中派人快马传信京城，告知北疆诡异态势。
萧琰早已料到张谦之行的目的，全程淡然应对，不遮不掩、不卑不亢，任由其巡查打探，实则处处皆是刻意营造的假象。他深知，想要破解朝堂构陷、粉碎丞相夺权阴谋，必先稳住眼前局势，再顺水推舟、引蛇出洞。
次日清晨，军中粮草仅剩最后一日，绝境愈发逼近，帐内不少将领心中焦灼难安，频频看向萧琰，等候下一步指令。众人心中皆有疑虑，如今仅靠虚张声势，终究难以长久支撑，粮草耗尽之日，便是假象破灭之时。
萧琰心知时机已到，即刻开启第二步计谋，顺水推舟，反制朝堂权臣。
他当众向卫凛提议：“如今朝堂追责在即，新任节度使将至，与其被动卸甲、任人构陷，不如主动请罪、自请核查。将军即刻上奏朝堂，直言粮草遭劫、军情危急，自请暂留军营，待击退北狄、稳固边防之后，再回京领罪。同时恳请圣上委派公正官员前来北疆核查实情，杜绝诬告构陷。”

众将闻言皆是不解，有人急切劝谏：“先生！如今我军本就深陷被动，主动请罪，岂不是自落把柄，任由朝堂拿捏？届时圣上震怒，无人能保将军性命！”
萧琰从容解释，语气沉稳通透：“诸位只需细想，圣上为何震怒？并非轻信御史弹劾，而是忌惮北疆兵权割据，担忧边将私通外敌、拥兵自重。我军若一味抗拒、拒不卸甲，只会坐实‘拥兵自重、心怀不轨’的罪名，届时圣上震怒，必派重兵围剿，内外夹击之下，我军必死无葬身之地。”
content_en:
Autumn, the third year of Yuanqi in the prosperous Tang Dynasty.
The new wind rolled up the dead leaves and slapped hard on the gate of the Zhenbei Army garrison. A desolate chill permeated the entire military camp. In just three days, the situation took a turn for the worse. The once impregnable defense line in Northern Xinjiang was now completely in dire straits.
Xiao Yan stood in front of the sand table in the Chinese army's tent. He was wearing a green gown that had been washed white, which was incompatible with the soldiers in the tent who were wearing armor and holding swords, and had serious expressions on their faces. He was originally an army counselor appointed by the court, with no military power or rank. He only relied on his intelligence to assist General Wei Lin in guarding the northern border. But now, he has become the only hope for the entire military camp to break the situation.
The atmosphere in the tent was as oppressive as solid ice. More than a dozen high-level generals lined up on both sides, all of them with pale faces and brows full of anxiety and anger. There were three letters of urgent intelligence spread out on the case. The ink was dripping with heart-wrenching words, and each word declared their embarrassment and crisis.
The first letter was a grain and grass intelligence report: the thousand-stone grain truck escorting grain and grass was hijacked in the Black Wind Gorge, and all the escorting soldiers died for their country. In the winter, 90% of the army's grain was lost. The entire army of 30,000 soldiers only had three days of rations left.
The second letter was an urgent report from the border defense: the Beidi cavalry took advantage of the opportunity and broke through three peripheral beacons. Now heavy troops are pressing on the border. They are only 80 miles away from the main camp and will arrive in the evening.
The third letter was a secret decree from the court: Yushitai impeached the Zhenbei Army for liaison with foreign enemies and false reporting of military exploits. The Holy Emperor was furious and ordered Wei Lin to immediately remove his armor and return to Beijing to await trial. The new Jiedu Envoy was already on the way and temporarily took over military affairs.
The three crises are stacked one on top of another, like three mountains crashing down. Lack of food, external enemies, internal doubts, and a desperate situation with no solution or escape.
"Counsellor Xiao, now that things have come to a close, you should say something!" A bearded general couldn't hold himself back, and took a step forward. His voice was hoarse and full of anxiety, "The food and grass are cut off, the enemy troops are pressing down on the border, and the court is still under pressure." We must defend the border to the death, but instead of dying on the battlefield, we will die because of the traitors in the court! Now that the soldiers are uneasy and have no countermeasures, our army will collapse without a fight!"
As soon as the words fell, a low echo suddenly sounded in the tent, carrying endless despair and resentment. The tension in the past few days has already exhausted everyone's confidence. Under the desperate situation, it is a foregone conclusion that the morale of the army will be weakened.
Coach Wei Lin was sitting on the throne, wearing cold and heavy armor. His once sharp eyes were now bloodshot, and his brows were full of exhaustion and weakness. He has been in charge of the Zhenbei Army for more than ten years and has guarded Northern Xinjiang in hundreds of battles. He has never been in such a dilemma.
"Everyone, please be patient." Wei Lin raised his hand to suppress the restlessness of the crowd. His gaze fell firmly on Xiao Yan in front of the sand table, and his tone was full of trust. "Mr. Xiao is unparalleled in his wit and scheming. He has been able to reverse the situation in many crises. Today's crisis is only possible for you. Only Mr. Wei Lin can solve the crisis. I, Wei Lin, have the honor and disgrace of my life and the lives of the thirty thousand soldiers of the Northern Army in this town. I will give it to Mr. Xiao. As long as you have orders, the whole army will obey you!"
When all the generals heard the sound, they all restrained their agitation and looked at Xiao Yan. Some people still have hope, while others have hidden doubts. Xiao Yan entered the scene at a young age, only twenty-five or twenty-six years old. Although he often came up with strange plans and accomplished extraordinary feats, the crisis he was facing now could not be solved by ordinary tactics, and everyone was unavoidably uneasy.
Xiao Yan slowly raised his eyes, his expression calm and calm, not a trace of panic or anxiety. In a desperate situation, the most fearful thing is to be impetuous and chaotic. Once the person in charge loses his composure, the whole army will be in ruins. He raised his hand and gently smoothed the messy terrain marks on the sand table. His fingertips were steady and strong. He glanced at everyone, and his voice was clear and determined, penetrating the melancholy of the room: "Although the situation is dangerous, it is not a dead end. The triple dilemma seems to be interlocking and unsolvable, but in fact there are flaws everywhere, which can be dismantled one by one and used to break the situation."
A few words, but like a ray of breeze breaking through the thick fog, adding a touch of life to the tight and oppressive tent. Everyone held their breath and waited quietly for his plan.
Xiao Yan turned around and walked to the case. He tapped the three intelligence reports with his fingertips and analyzed them slowly and clearly: "The food and grass were robbed. It seemed that the foundation was broken, but in fact it was robbed."Those who provide food are not soldiers and horses of Beidi. The terrain of Heifeng Gorge is steep, and the Beidi cavalry is good at charging in the wilderness, but not good at ambush in the mountains. Moreover, no one was left alive during the robbery, no weapons were taken, and only grain and grass were burned. The purpose was not to plunder supplies, but to deliberately break the morale of our army and disrupt our position. "
He revealed the key point with one sentence, and all the generals were startled. Previously, everyone believed that it was Beidi who did it, and never got to the bottom of it.
“Look at the court impeachment again. "Xiao Yan picked up the secret edict, rubbed the cold rice paper with his fingertips, and his eyes darkened a bit, "The Yushitai suddenly launched an attack. It coincided with the intense war in northern Xinjiang and the plunder of food and grass. The timing was too coincidental. The new Jiedushi Zhao Huaian, who had always relied on the Prime Minister's party, came to take over military affairs in a hurry, with the intention of seizing power rather than fending off enemies. Prime Minister Su Yong has always been afraid of the excessive military power of the Zhenbei Army, and has long wanted to reduce its power. This time, he took advantage of the power of foreign enemies and the loss of food and grass to trap our army and take back the military power of Northern Xinjiang in one fell swoop. "
“As for Beidi Yajing, it is an excellent opportunity. "Xiao Yan's gaze returned to the sand table, and his fingertips crossed the eighty-mile open plain, "Beidi knew that our army was suffering from internal worries, its morale was unstable, and its food and grass were running out, so it took advantage of the situation to send troops, hoping to reap the benefits. The three forces each have their own agenda. It seems that they are encircling and blocking our army's survival, but in fact, they all have their own agenda and are not in charge of each other. The flaw lies in the discord of people's hearts and different agendas. "
After a thorough analysis, we peeled away the symptoms of the crisis and got to the core. The generals suddenly understood, their anxiety and panic faded away, and the light of hope rekindled in their eyes.
"What you said is absolutely true! "The anxious general said in a deep voice, "It's just that knowing the crux is easy, but solving the dilemma is difficult. Now there are only three days of food and grass left, the enemy is close at hand, and the court is about to hold us accountable, how can we deal with it? "
The corners of Xiao Yan's lips curved into a steady arc, and the words were clear: "The way to break the situation is divided into three steps. First, bluffing to stabilize the morale of the army and confuse foreign enemies; second, go along with the current, disrupt the court and prevent powerful ministers from seizing power; third, use force to severely damage Beidi and stabilize the overall situation in Northern Xinjiang. Linking everything together and working step by step, the crisis can be resolved within ten days. "
He turned to Wei Lin and bowed to ask for orders: "General, if you believe me, Xiao Yan, from today onwards, the entire army will be at my disposal. There is no need to ask why, just act according to the order. During this period, no matter what the outside world says or what happens in the military, the morale of the military cannot be shaken, okay? "
Wei Lin did not hesitate, stood up suddenly, raised his hand and took off the tiger charm from his waist, placed it heavily on the case, and said in a sonorous and powerful voice: "All the Northern Army in the town, please listen to sir's orders! Anyone who violates the order will be punished by military law! "
The tiger talisman fell to the ground, and the sound shook the tent. In the desperate situation, the military spirit was completely concentrated.
Xiao Yan stopped talking and issued orders immediately. The instructions were clear, organized, and implemented accurately.
"First order. The entire army immediately reorganized the camp, repaired the beacons, and strengthened the defense line. The soldiers of each battalion patrolled the camp day and night, with flags out and trumpets blowing constantly. They must have sufficient food and grass, stable military morale, and a ready attitude. Orders were sent to each stove to fire the three meals as usual, and the smoke was constant. Even if the porridge and grain were diluted, the fireworks must be kept in full bloom, so that the outside world could not get a glimpse of the fact that our army was short of food. "
"Second order. The scouts were ordered to gallop out in three groups, sneaking into the Black Wind Gorge to secretly detect the traces of grain-robbery soldiers and horses, and retain physical evidence; they went all the way north to investigate the Beidi garrison and grain and grass camps; they rushed all the way to the capital, secretly contacted officials loyal to the royal family and opposed the Prime Minister's faction, and conveyed the true situation in Northern Xinjiang. "
"The third order. The truth behind the robbery of grain and fodder was sealed, and private discussion of grain and fodder matters was strictly prohibited in the military. Violators were severely punished. Externally, it was only announced that the transportation of grain and grass was slow and would arrive in a few days, so as to stabilize the morale of the army and confuse foreign enemies and the court to work carefully. "
Military orders were issued at all levels, and the fast horses immediately came out of the camp. The silent and depressing military camp instantly became operational, with everyone performing their duties in an orderly manner, sweeping away the previous decline.
At night, the wind becomes stronger and the chill is biting. The lights of the military camp were brightly lit, and the lights of the tents stretching for dozens of miles were kept burning. The horn sounded on time every two hours with a mighty sound. Looking from a distance, the entire main buildingThe camp's fortifications were tight, its morale was high, and there was no sign of decline at all.
The Beidi scouts were lurking in the distant mountains and forests, spying all night long. Seeing this scene, they were shocked and suspicious, and reported to the commander overnight: The Northern Army in Dasheng Town has sufficient food and grass, a stable military morale, and tight defenses. They cannot attack rashly, but need to postpone the advance and wait and see what happens.
When the commander of Beidi received the intelligence report, he was really frightened. He immediately ordered the entire army to stop for eighty miles and camp on the spot to rest and not dare to approach rashly. Beidi was cunning and suspicious by nature, and had always been afraid of the strong and the weak. Seeing that the Zhenbei Army was not losing momentum, he was afraid of hiding an ambush and rashly marching into a trap, so he stopped his troops abruptly.
The first step of the strategy successfully delayed the enemy's attack without spending a single soldier, and gained valuable buffer time for subsequent breakthroughs.
At the same time, the supervisory troops sent by the court quickly arrived at the military camp. This person's name is Zhang Qian, and he is a confidant of Prime Minister Su Yong. He came here to supervise military affairs, but in fact he secretly collected evidence and cooperated with Zhao Huaian in seizing power, with the intention of convicting the Beijun Army.
After Zhang Qian entered the camp, he patrolled around, deliberately inquired, and secretly observed the grain and grass storage and the status of the soldiers. He found that the camp was in good order, with endless smoke, and the morale of the soldiers was high. It did not look like a desperate situation where food and grass were cut off and the morale of the soldiers was slack. He was puzzled, but he did not relax his vigilance. He secretly sent someone to send a message to the capital to inform him of the strange situation in northern Xinjiang.
Xiao Yan had already anticipated the purpose of Zhang Qian's trip, and dealt with it calmly throughout the whole process. He did not cover up or hide, neither humble nor overbearing, and allowed him to patrol and inquire. In fact, everything was a deliberately created illusion. He knew very well that if he wanted to break the trap in the court and smash the prime minister's conspiracy to seize power, he must first stabilize the situation at hand, and then follow the current and lure the snake out of the hole.
In the early morning of the next day, there was only one day of food and grass left in the army, and the desperate situation was getting closer. Many generals in the tent were anxious and uneasy, and they frequently looked at Xiao Yan, waiting for the next order. Everyone has doubts in their hearts. Now it is impossible to sustain it for long by just relying on bluff. The day when the food and grass are exhausted, it is the time when the illusion is shattered.
Xiao Yan knew that the time had come, and immediately launched the second step of his strategy to follow the current and counterattack the powerful officials in the court.
He proposed to Wei Lin in public: "Now that the court will be held accountable, and the new Jiedushi is coming, instead of passively removing his armor and allowing others to frame him, it is better to take the initiative to plead guilty and ask for verification. The general immediately reported to the court, frankly saying that the food and grass were robbed and the military situation was critical. He asked to stay in the barracks temporarily, and after repelling Beidi and stabilizing the border defense, he would return to Beijing to accept the crime. At the same time, I implore the Holy Emperor to appoint impartial officials to come to Northern Xinjiang to verify the truth and put an end to false accusations and frame-ups."
All the generals were puzzled when they heard the words, and some people eagerly advised him: "Sir! Now that our army is already passive, if we take the initiative to plead guilty, wouldn't we be letting the court manipulate us? By then the Holy Emperor will be furious, and no one can save the general's life!"
Xiao Yan explained calmly and in a calm and transparent tone: "Everyone just needs to think carefully, why is the Holy Emperor so angry? It's not that he trusts the censor's impeachment, but he is afraid of the separatist military power in northern Xinjiang, and he is worried that the border generals will liaise with foreign enemies and support their own troops. If our army blindly resists and refuses to remove its armor, it will only be found guilty of "supporting its own troops and having evil intentions." When the time comes, the Holy One will be angry and will send heavy troops to encircle and suppress us. Under attack from both inside and outside, our army will die without a burial place. "
